items.title: Lawrence Trotter Interview, 1966-01-13
items.q: Willie James Squeak was playing third. ... Squeak is from here. That's Willie James. That's Louis James' nephew.

ctx.x: You didn't worry about that. Kid. You went to Kildee was in there, huh? What was he playing?

Trumpet. Second trumpet. Gaudet was playing first trumpet. Celestine was playing third. You have a trombone player? Bill Matthews was playing trombone. Tom Johnson was playing first alto. Willie James Squeak was playing third. Cyclone and Clarence Hall was playing tenor.
Squeak is from here. Where is he from?

items.title: Lawrence Trotter Interview, 1966-01-13
items.q: You heard of him? Called him Wiggles. Well, he made a record with David Jones when they were at the Astoria.

ctx.x: You heard of him? Called him Wiggles. Well, he made a record with David Jones when they were at the Astoria. Is that the same time? Same. That's right. Did you ever hear Lee Collins? Lee Collins. Lee Collins. Lee Collins. Lee Collins was playing trumpet. Oh, yeah?
Oh, yeah. Joe Robichaux was playing piano. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Roy Evans was playing drums. Did they have a guitar or anything like that?
